title: Austria's Foreign Ministry reports unauthorized access via an external provider's website
date_note: Date of the ministry communiqué as relayed by N+ (Friday, 20 November); the access is reported as 12 to 13 November.
geo_basis: agency headquarters (Vienna, as the article refers to staff in Vienna)
summary: N+ reports that Austria's Foreign Ministry said in a communiqué that unauthorized access occurred on 12 and 13 November through a website run by an external service provider. Per N+, it was detected on 13 November and blocked immediately. N+ says staff names and contact details were exposed, but also says personal data was ruled out; the article is inconsistent.
plain: Austria's Foreign Ministry reportedly said someone got into a website run by an outside provider on 12 and 13 November. It was blocked once found.
exec: A government ministry reports an intrusion through a supplier's website; supplier-hosted sites can be a way into organisations.
impact: Scope of staff data affected is unclear in the source.

validation.note: Only N+ read; the ministry's own communiqué was not found or read. The article contradicts itself on whether personal data was exposed.
